title: Tag vote
description: One household's assertion about one app and one tag. Carries a rotating contributor id, never a child, a name or any usage.

app.description: Namespaced app key, see SPEC.md section 3.9.

contributor_id.description: A random id the client mints for the community layer. Separate from Household.id and never derived from it. The parent may rotate it at any time (SPEC.md 7.2).

evidence.description: A store or IGDB page for the app. Nothing else: the server does not accept uploads or links to images in 0.1.

note.description: Why the tag fits. Must not contain names or anything about a child. The server may strip or reject it.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 with an explicit offset (Z or +hh:mm).
